job.job_description:
Education: Currently in your final year (2025/2026 batch) or a recent graduate with a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related logic-heavy field.
The AI Baseline: You have hands-on, personal experience tinkering with LLMs.
If your only use of ChatGPT is asking it to write a cover letter, this role is not for you.
We want to see how you ve tried to break, bypass, or build with these models.
Core Technical Skills: Strong foundational programming skills in Python.
You must be comfortable writing scripts, managing JSON data, and interacting with REST APIs.
Linguistic Logic: Prompt engineering is essentially programming in plain English.
You must possess exceptional written communication skills and a deep understanding of context and nuance.
Problem-Solving: A proven ability to break down complex, ambiguous business problems into step-by-step logical instructions.
Advanced Prompt Engineering: Design, test, iterate, and refine complex prompts for LLMs (GPT-4, Claude, Llama) to generate highly accurate, business-specific outputs.
AI Workflow Automation: Build and deploy intelligent agents and automated pipelines using frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen.
Quality Assurance "Red Teaming": Rigorously test AI models for hallucinations, biases, and edge cases.
You will act as the logic gatekeeper for AI outputs.
API Integration: Write clean, efficient Python scripts to connect LLM APIs to internal databases, client dashboards, and third-party platforms.
Continuous Innovation: Monitor daily advancements in the Generative AI space, rapid-prototype new use cases, and present your findings to our senior consulting team.
Company: Cabirx Job Type: Full-Time (Probationary to Permanent) Experience Level: Entry-Level (Targeting 2025 2026 Graduates) Department: Emerging Technologies AI Consulting At Cabirx, we are not just another IT consulting firm; we are architecting the future of enterprise technology.
Operating across India and expanding rapidly into the Dubai and broader Middle East (GCC) markets, we specialize in deploying next-generation tech solutions specifically Generative AI, intelligent automation, and financial technology implementations.
We operate on a pure meritocracy.
We move fast, we build scalable solutions, and we cut out the corporate red tape.




Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
